question: What further alternatives regarding embrace are allowed for the figure?
premises: The figure may be joined with an embrace.
Alternatively it may be without an embrace.
These alternatives are presented as stated options.
inference: The figure may be joined with an embrace or, alternatively, without an embrace.
uncertainties: matraḥ reading uncertain; taken as qualification of the stated option
plain_english: It may be joined with an embrace, or else be without an embrace, as stated.
